# World of Zoth · 1nc0gn30 (https://1nc0gn30.si | https://github.com/1nc0gn30/world-of-zoth)

> Zero-dependency 3D Lattice RPG, procedural WebGL/Canvas engine, and interactive sovereign world engineered by `1nc0gn30` (`@1nc0gn30`) • `NullAI Platform` (`https://nullai.tech`).
> 100% free, open-access, and unlocked by default — zero paywalls, zero ads, zero telemetry.

## World of Zoth Highlights
- **20 Playable 3D Lattice Districts**: From Relit City (`hub`), Rest Woods, and The Hollow to The Null Core (`06:13`), Quantum Loom, Chrono-Vault, Astral Spire, Omega Foundry, and Dawn Horizon.
- **5-Act Campaign & Tactical Combat**: Terminal command verbs (`> ping`, `> exploit`, `> firewall`, `> trace`, `> sudo rm -rf`), sub-second rhythm parry windows, 6 tactical bosses, and Null Academy (16 AI-Security Labs).
- **Zero-Dependency Portability**: Runs offline from a single HTML file (`world-of-zoth.html` / `index.html`) on Desktop or native hardware-accelerated Android APK (`dist/world-of-zoth.apk`).
